result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: restaurant names truncated in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete delivery fee text under one card.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol'), making the full name unreadable even though the card image and delivery time are fully shown.
issues.suggestion: Allow restaurant titles to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure card width and truncation (e.g. ellipsis) keep the name identifiable without mid-word clipping.

issues.description: The delivery fee under Green Bowl Poké shows '€0.90 delvery' with 'delivery' misspelled/truncated as 'delvery'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the label to the full word 'delivery' and ensure text is not truncated on the card.
